provenance.method: Steam developer/publisher listing checked on 2026-09-02. Steam discovery was used to find the candidate; governed wording records only developer-described play structure and access characteristics, not user tags or a neurodivergence-specific benefit claim.

name: Tiny Glade
description: A free-form single-player diorama builder centred on making castles, cottages and ruins, with no management, combat, goals or failure states in the developer-described core play.
intended_use: Inspect when looking for open-ended building play without objectives, scoring, combat or a fail state.
audience_or_context: General-audience players browsing by preferred play characteristics rather than diagnosis. The listing does not claim that the game is calming or suitable for a neurodivergent person.
limitations: Visual motion, sound, camera movement and the creative interface can still be a poor fit for some players even without failure states.
The current record does not establish a complete accessibility-settings inventory or alternative-input support.
A lack of goals or failure does not mean every player will experience the game as relaxing.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial PC game distributed through Steam; price and platform availability can change.
conflicts_of_interest: The Steam store description is developer/publisher-supplied commercial product information; ND Oracle records bounded product characteristics without adopting promotional claims of relaxation.
